worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.summary: Fires a shadow arrow: on a hit it deals piercing damage and stitches the target's shadow to the ground - the target is trapped and cannot flee until the duration ends or the thread is torn by an outside force. Deep pins longer but is slower and shorter; Quick is faster and farther but holds less.
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.use.0: Pin a fleeing target in place for allies to finish
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.use.1: Break a target's movement at mid to long range
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.use.2: Lock a thick target into the melee
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.use.3: Trap a target in the open together with allies
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.descript: The shadow arrow deals about %1$s piercing damage; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
It fires up to %1$s blocks, at about %2$s blocks per tick.
On a hit the shadow is pinned for about %1$s; dragged more than %2$s blocks from the anchor the thread snaps and the pin is released.
The shadow is bound by about %1$s threads, over a shadow pool of about %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.option.o: Deep: power about x1.15, pin duration about x1.4 and snap distance +0.5 blocks, at wind-up +4 and cooldown +8 ticks and reach -1 block - a longer pin that is slower and shorter ranged.
Quick: a faster cast, longer reach and shorter cooldown, at the cost of a shorter pin that tears more easily.
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.timing: Fire up to %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.growth.0: At level %1$s the piercing power rises to %2$s and the pin to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.spiritshackle.preferen: On: power about x1.15, pin duration about x1.4 and snap distance +0.5 blocks, at wind-up +4 and cooldown +8 ticks and reach -1 block - a longer pin, slower and shorter ranged, for locking down a fleeing thick target. Off (Quick): a faster cast, longer reach and shorter cooldown, at the cost of a shorter pin that tears more easily, for breaking a target's movement at mid to long range.
The companion only fires at a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher lets it pin a target from afar.
On: a fleeing target scores one tier higher - one arrow stitches its shadow so it cannot get away; off: ranked as an ordinary ranged attack. An already trapped target is never re-pinned.
